snippet.title: Fallen Fates - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Fallen Fates is our new game project, prepare for vast areas to explore, epic fights, beautiful cinematics and memorable characters!

Kickstarter Campaign in September - https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hibernian-workshop/fallen-fates

Join the community - https://discord.gg/hibernian-workshop
